stories.title: “Incredibly disappointing”: IFS on council tax delay that keeps Flintshire on 2003 values
stories.summary: Flintshire homes could stay in council tax bands based on 2003 property values until 2032, under Welsh Government plans the Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS) has called “incredibly disappointing”. stories.title: Petrol at highest price since 2022 as inflation reaches 3.5%
